newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Banking Corp to set $60 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: China Banking Corp to set $60 mln FRCD.

text.p: China Banking Corp is expected to launch a US$60 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue into general syndication later today, bankers said.
They said LTCB Asia, Standard Chartered Bank, Development Bank of Singapore and AFC Merchant Bank are arranging the deal.
The certificates will have a tenor of three years and pay a coupon of 85 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.

The issuer completed a US$50 million three-year FRCD issue last August that was arranged by LTCB Asia. It paid a coupon of 85 basis points over LIBOR and, with fees, an all-in return of 94 basis points.
